# Hutsix — Windows Automation Toolkit

> Hutsix is a Windows desktop automation platform built with Python and PySide6. It automates repetitive keyboard and mouse workflows through a visual, profile-based system with no coding required. Triggers (global hotkeys, pixel color, image match, OCR text, trained AI image model) drive keyboard/mouse action sequences, with per-binding diagnostics, focus guard, cooldowns, and optional CUDA GPU acceleration for AI/vision workloads. Runs on Windows 10/11 (64-bit). Free 7-day trial, then a one-time $49 USD license.

- [Hutsix vs GS Auto Clicker](https://archangel-77.github.io/hutsix-public/vs/gs-auto-clicker/): Timer-based clicking versus screen-aware conditional automation

## Key facts
- Platform: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
- Price: one-time $49 USD, no subscription
- Download: Softpedia listing for the free trial; latest build on GitHub Releases
- License: Proprietary software with a free 7-day trial
- The trial cannot be reset by reinstalling
- Typical usage is fully UI-driven (no coding required)
